content.comment_body: Hello! I have a [product_name] [article_no] PLC. For this device, I can use digital input I3 with a capability of 5 kHz. Is it possible to change the frequency setting? Information: Normal inputs allow a maximum of 4 Hz, while high-speed inputs can reach up to 5 kHz.

It is not possible to adjust the frequency settings; the hardware determines these limits. Simply connect I3 to I6 in your [product_name] program directly to a counter or digital threshold trigger, without placing any additional blocks between the input and the counter/trigger. Kind regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user seeks to alter the input frequency for a digital channel on their [product_name] PLC, but finds that this setting is fixed by hardware and cannot be configured in software. Guidance is given on how to properly implement high-frequency counting, emphasizing the hardware-imposed limitations of frequency adjustment.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to be able to configure or modify the frequency handling of the PLC's digital input according to their specific requirements.
